#!/bin/sh

SSH_OPTS="-o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) backup of ${SRC_HOST}:${SRC_DIR} -> ${DEST_DIR} completed" >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log
